defaults.note: Identical to the FaceIt defaults except capacity: Retake holds 9 players, every other mode 10.

plugins.name: RetakesPluginShared
plugins.note: Shared API library RetakesPlugin links against; loads from the CSS shared/ path, not plugins/.

plugins.name: PanelBridge
plugins.note: Shared single copy in manager/shared/plugins/PanelBridge, built from the project below. Exposes SteamID64 player data over RCON for the panel.

configs.name: server.cfg
configs.note: Shared base profile in manager/shared/cfg/server.cfg, mounted into every mode and exec'd first by mode_retake.cfg. Mode files carry only their own convars on top of it.

configs.name: RetakesPlugin.json
configs.note: Mounted over the plugin's auto-generated copy so the panel owns it. EnableFallbackAllocation stays true: RetakesPlugin does its own weapon allocation here, since no allocator plugin is installed. MaxPlayers matches settings.defaults.capacity.

actions.label: Force Bombsite A
actions.description: Forces future retake rounds to use bombsite A.

actions.label: Force Bombsite B
actions.description: Forces future retake rounds to use bombsite B.

actions.label: Restore Automatic Bombsite
actions.description: Returns bombsite selection to the Retakes plugin.

actions.label: Scramble Teams
actions.description: Reassigns connected players between retake teams.

actions.label: Show Retake Queue
actions.description: Prints the current retake queue to the console.
